newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor will seek alternatives in Spain.
newsitem.headline: Usinor will seek alternatives in Spain.

text.p: French steel group Usinor said it a statement that it intended to strengthen its position in Spain despite the rejection of its bid for 35 percent in CSI.
Spain's Agencia Industrial de Estado (IEA) on Tuesday decided to sell a 35 percent stake in Corporacion Siderurgics Integral (CSI) to Luxembourg's Arbed.
The decision needs to be confirmed by the Spanish government.
Usinor was the only other candidate.
"The Usinor group will continue to strengthen its position on the Spanish market, building on its relationships with partners Condesa, Bamesa and Gonvarri," it said in a statement.
"Usinor will follow its strategy of considering alternatives for expansion through internal growth or acquisition," it added.
